us-20261016-news-3.title: Pemula yang Terlambat: Mengapa Pembeli Rumah Pertama Semakin Tua Seiring Harga dan Suku Bunga Menekan Akses Masuk

segments.src: ## A longer road to the front door
segments.tr: ## Jalan yang lebih panjang menuju pintu depan

segments.src: For decades, buying a first home was treated as a milestone of one's twenties or early thirties.
segments.tr: Selama beberapa dekade, membeli rumah pertama dianggap sebagai tonggak sejarah di usia dua puluhan atau awal tiga puluhan.

segments.src: That picture no longer matches the data.
segments.tr: Gambaran itu tidak lagi sesuai dengan data.

segments.src: According to recent figures from the National Association of Realtors, the typical first-time buyer in the United States is now around 38 years old, a record high and a sharp rise from the low thirties that was the norm a generation ago.
segments.tr: Menurut angka terbaru dari National Association of Realtors, pembeli rumah pertama di Amerika Serikat kini berusia sekitar 38 tahun, rekor tertinggi dan lonjakan tajam dari usia awal tiga puluhan yang menjadi norma satu generasi lalu.

segments.src: At the same time, first-time buyers account for a smaller share of all home purchases than at any point in the survey's history, at roughly a quarter of transactions in recent annual readings, compared with about four in ten over the long-run average.
segments.tr: Pada saat yang sama, pembeli rumah pertama menyumbang porsi yang lebih kecil dari semua pembelian rumah dibandingkan titik mana pun dalam sejarah survei, yaitu sekitar seperempat dari transaksi dalam pembacaan tahunan baru-baru ini, dibandingkan dengan sekitar empat dari sepuluh dalam rata-rata jangka panjang.

segments.src: Taken together, these numbers describe a market in which getting onto the property ladder takes longer, and in which fewer people manage it in any given year.
segments.tr: Jika digabungkan, angka-angka ini menggambarkan pasar di mana untuk masuk ke tangga properti membutuhkan waktu lebih lama, dan di mana lebih sedikit orang yang berhasil melakukannya dalam tahun tertentu.

segments.src: ## Three pressures at once
segments.tr: ## Tiga tekanan sekaligus

segments.src: No single factor explains the shift.
segments.tr: Tidak ada satu faktor tunggal yang menjelaskan pergeseran tersebut.

segments.src: Instead, three pressures have stacked on top of one another.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, tiga tekanan telah menumpuk di atas satu sama lain.

segments.src: **High prices.** Home values rose sharply in the years after 2020 and have largely held their gains.
segments.tr: **Harga tinggi.** Nilai rumah naik tajam pada tahun-tahun setelah 2020 dan sebagian besar mempertahankan kenaikannya.

segments.src: The national median existing-home price has climbed well above $400,000, and in many metropolitan areas it is far higher.
segments.tr: Median harga rumah nasional yang ada telah naik jauh di atas $400.000, dan di banyak wilayah metropolitan jauh lebih tinggi.

segments.src: Incomes have grown, but not at the same pace, which stretches the number of years a household needs to save for a down payment.
segments.tr: Pendapatan telah tumbuh, tetapi tidak pada laju yang sama, yang memperpanjang jumlah tahun yang dibutuhkan rumah tangga untuk menabung demi uang muka.

segments.src: **Elevated mortgage rates.** The era of ultra-low borrowing costs is over.
segments.tr: **Suku bunga hipotek yang tinggi.** Era biaya pinjaman yang sangat rendah telah berakhir.

segments.src: With 30-year fixed rates well above the levels seen in 2020 and 2021, the monthly payment on the same house is substantially larger.
segments.tr: Dengan suku bunga tetap 30 tahun yang jauh di atas tingkat yang terlihat pada 2020 dan 2021, cicilan bulanan untuk rumah yang sama secara substansial lebih besar.

segments.src: A buyer borrowing $350,000 at 7 percent pays several hundred dollars more each month than one borrowing the same amount at 4 percent, before taxes and insurance.
segments.tr: Seorang pembeli yang meminjam $350.000 pada 7 persen membayar beberapa ratus dolar lebih banyak setiap bulan daripada seseorang yang meminjam jumlah yang sama pada 4 persen, sebelum pajak dan asuransi.

segments.src: **Thin inventory.** Many existing owners locked in low rates and are reluctant to sell and take on a new, more expensive loan.
segments.tr: **Persediaan yang menipis.** Banyak pemilik yang ada mengunci suku bunga rendah dan enggan untuk menjual dan mengambil pinjaman baru yang lebih mahal.

segments.src: That "lock-in effect" has kept the supply of homes for sale tight, especially in the entry-level segment where first-time buyers tend to shop.
segments.tr: Efek penguncian tersebut telah menjaga pasokan rumah untuk dijual tetap ketat, terutama di segmen tingkat pemula tempat pembeli pertama cenderung berbelanja.

segments.src: Fewer listings mean more competition and less room to negotiate.
segments.tr: Lebih sedikit daftar berarti lebih banyak persaingan dan lebih sedikit ruang untuk negosiasi.

segments.src: ## Who is getting in, and how
segments.tr: ## Siapa yang masuk, dan bagaimana caranya

segments.src: The buyers who do succeed often share certain characteristics.
segments.tr: Pembeli yang berhasil sering kali memiliki karakteristik tertentu.

segments.src: They are more likely to be married or partnered with two incomes, to have received help with the down payment from family, or to live in lower-cost regions.
segments.tr: Mereka lebih mungkin untuk menikah atau memiliki pasangan dengan dua penghasilan, telah menerima bantuan uang muka dari keluarga, atau tinggal di daerah berbiaya lebih rendah.

segments.src: Single buyers and renters in expensive coastal cities face the steepest climb.
segments.tr: Pembeli lajang dan penyewa di kota-kota pesisir yang mahal menghadapi pendakian yang paling curam.

segments.src: Some households adapt by changing what they buy rather than whether they buy.
segments.tr: Beberapa rumah tangga beradaptasi dengan mengubah apa yang mereka beli daripada apakah mereka membeli.

segments.src: Common strategies include:
segments.tr: Strategi umum meliputi:

segments.src: - Choosing smaller homes, condominiums or townhouses over single-family houses
segments.tr: - Memilih rumah yang lebih kecil, kondominium, atau townhouse daripada rumah tapak

segments.src: - Moving to more affordable metro areas or commuter towns
segments.tr: - Pindah ke area metro yang lebih terjangkau atau kota komuter

segments.src: - Pooling resources with a partner, relative or friend
segments.tr: - Menggabungkan sumber daya dengan pasangan, kerabat, atau teman

segments.src: - Using down-payment assistance programs offered by states and localities
segments.tr: - Menggunakan program bantuan uang muka yang ditawarkan oleh negara bagian dan daerah

segments.src: - Renting longer while building savings and improving credit
segments.tr: - Menyewa lebih lama sambil membangun tabungan dan meningkatkan kredit

segments.src: ## The wider consequences
segments.tr: ## Konsekuensi yang lebih luas

segments.src: A later start has effects beyond the housing market.
segments.tr: Permulaan yang lebih lambat memiliki efek di luar pasar perumahan.

segments.src: Homeownership is the primary way most American households build wealth, and equity accumulates over time.
segments.tr: Kepemilikan rumah adalah cara utama sebagian besar rumah tangga Amerika membangun kekayaan, dan ekuitas terakumulasi dari waktu ke waktu.

segments.src: A buyer who enters at 38 rather than 28 has fewer years to pay down a mortgage before retirement and fewer years of appreciation to benefit from.
segments.tr: Seorang pembeli yang masuk pada usia 38 daripada 28 memiliki lebih sedikit tahun untuk melunasi hipotek sebelum pensiun dan lebih sedikit tahun apresiasi untuk mendapat manfaat darinya.

segments.src: Economists also point to links with household formation, family size and mobility, since people tend to delay other major decisions when housing is out of reach.
segments.tr: Ekonom juga menunjukkan hubungan dengan pembentukan rumah tangga, ukuran keluarga, dan mobilitas, karena orang cenderung menunda keputusan besar lainnya ketika perumahan tidak terjangkau.

segments.src: There is also a generational dimension.
segments.tr: Ada juga dimensi generasi.

segments.src: Older buyers who already own are, in many cases, staying in their homes longer, which reduces turnover and compounds the supply problem for younger households.
segments.tr: Pembeli yang lebih tua yang sudah memiliki rumah, dalam banyak kasus, tinggal di rumah mereka lebih lama, yang mengurangi perputaran dan memperparah masalah pasokan untuk rumah tangga yang lebih muda.

segments.src: ## What could change the picture
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dapat mengubah gambaran tersebut

segments.src: Analysts generally see no quick fix.
segments.tr: Analis umumnya melihat tidak ada perbaikan cepat.

segments.src: Lower mortgage rates would help payments but could also unlock demand faster than supply can respond, putting upward pressure on prices.
segments.tr: Suku bunga hipotek yang lebih rendah akan membantu pembayaran tetapi juga dapat membuka permintaan lebih cepat daripada pasokan dapat merespons, memberikan tekanan ke atas pada harga.

segments.src: Increasing construction, particularly of modest, lower-priced homes, is widely cited as the most durable remedy, though zoning rules, labor shortages and building costs slow that response.
segments.tr: Meningkatkan konstruksi, terutama rumah yang sederhana dan berharga lebih rendah, secara luas disebut sebagai obat yang paling tahan lama, meskipun aturan zonasi, kekurangan tenaga kerja, dan biaya bangunan memperlambat respons tersebut.

segments.src: For prospective buyers, the practical takeaway is to plan around a longer timeline: build savings, understand the full monthly cost of ownership, compare programs available locally, and be realistic about the trade-offs between location, size and price.
segments.tr: Bagi calon pembeli, pelajaran praktisnya adalah merencanakan sekitar garis waktu yang lebih panjang: membangun tabungan, memahami biaya bulanan penuh kepemilikan, membandingkan program yang tersedia secara lokal, dan bersikap realistis tentang trade-off antara lokasi, ukuran, dan harga.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat keuangan atau real estat.

segments.src: Figures are approximate and may vary by source and reporting period.*
segments.tr: Angka-angka adalah perkiraan dan dapat bervariasi menurut sumber dan periode pelaporan.*

us-20261016-news-2.title: Mengapa Malam Pemilu Jarang Berakhir pada Malam Pemilu: Bagaimana Surat Suara Dihitung, Negara Bagian demi Negara Bagian

segments.src: Every election cycle, viewers watch the clock on election night and wonder why some races are called within minutes of the polls closing while others stay open for days.
segments.tr: Setiap siklus pemilu, pemirsa melihat jam pada malam pemilu dan bertanya-tanya mengapa beberapa pemilihan diumumkan dalam hitungan menit setelah tempat pemungutan suara ditutup sementara yang lain tetap buka selama berhari-hari.

segments.src: The explanation is usually not fraud, incompetence, or mystery.
segments.tr: Penjelasannya biasanya bukanlah kecurangan, ketidak kompetenan, atau misteri.

segments.src: It is a patchwork of state laws that govern when mail ballots can be processed, how long they can arrive, and when results become official.
segments.tr: Itu adalah kumpulan undang-undang negara bagian yang mengatur kapan surat suara dapat diproses, berapa lama mereka dapat tiba, dan kapan hasil menjadi resmi.

segments.src: ## "Counting" Is Several Different Steps
segments.tr: ## "Penghitungan" Adalah Beberapa Langkah Berbeda

segments.src: Before comparing states, it helps to separate the steps that often get lumped together as "counting."
segments.tr: Sebelum membandingkan negara bagian, ada baiknya memisahkan langkah-langkah yang sering digabungkan sebagai "penghitungan."

segments.src: - **Receipt:** The election office receives the returned ballot envelope.
segments.tr: - **Penerimaan:** Kantor pemilu menerima amplop surat suara yang dikembalikan.

segments.src: - **Verification:** Staff check the voter's signature or other identifying information, confirm the voter is eligible, and make sure the voter has not already voted.
segments.tr: - **Verifikasi:** Staf memeriksa tanda tangan pemilih atau informasi pengenal lainnya, mengonfirmasi bahwa pemilih memenuhi syarat, dan memastikan pemilih belum pernah memilih.

segments.src: - **Processing (sometimes called pre-canvassing):** Envelopes are opened, ballots are removed and flattened, and they are prepared for scanning. In many places this can happen before Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Pemrosesan (kadang-kadang disebut pra-kanvas):** Amplop dibuka, surat suara dikeluarkan dan diratakan, serta disiapkan untuk dipindai. Di banyak tempat, ini dapat terjadi sebelum Hari Pemilu.

segments.src: - **Tabulation:** Ballots are run through scanners and the votes are added to the totals. Many states restrict when tabulation may begin, and most do not publish results until polls close.
segments.tr: - **Tabulasi:** Surat suara dijalankan melalui pemindai dan suara ditambahkan ke total. Banyak negara bagian membatasi kapan tabulasi dapat dimulai, dan kebanyakan tidak mempublikasikan hasil sampai tempat pemungutan suara ditutup.

segments.src: - **Canvass and certification:** Officials reconcile the numbers, resolve problem ballots, run required audits, and formally certify the final results.
segments.tr: - **Kanvas dan sertifikasi:** Pejabat merekonsiliasi angka, menyelesaikan masalah surat suara, melakukan audit yang diperlukan, dan secara resmi mengesahkan hasil akhir.

segments.src: A state may allow early processing but not early tabulation, or allow both.
segments.tr: Suatu negara bagian mungkin mengizinkan pemrosesan awal tetapi bukan tabulasi awal, atau mengizinkan keduanya.

segments.src: Each variation changes how quickly a large pile of mail ballots turns into reported votes.
segments.tr: Setiap variasi mengubah seberapa cepat setumpuk besar surat suara berubah menjadi suara yang dilaporkan.

segments.src: ## Three Rules That Shape the Timeline
segments.tr: ## Tiga Aturan yang Membentuk Garis Waktu

segments.src: ### 1. When Can Officials Start Processing?
segments.tr: ### 1. Kapan Pejabat Dapat Memulai Pemrosesan?

segments.src: Some states let election workers begin opening and preparing mail ballots weeks ahead of Election Day, so that on election night they only need to scan and report.
segments.tr: Beberapa negara bagian mengizinkan pekerja pemilu mulai membuka dan menyiapkan surat suara berminggu-minggu sebelum Hari Pemilu, sehingga pada malam pemilu mereka hanya perlu memindai dan melaporkan.

segments.src: Others restrict processing until Election Day itself, or even until the polls close.
segments.tr: Yang lain membatasi pemrosesan hingga Hari Pemilu itu sendiri, atau bahkan sampai tempat pemungutan suara ditutup.

segments.src: In those states, a large volume of mail ballots must be handled by the same staff who are also running in-person voting, which naturally slows the count.
segments.tr: Di negara-negara bagian tersebut, volume surat suara yang besar harus ditangani oleh staf yang sama yang juga menjalankan pemungutan suara langsung, yang secara alami memperlambat penghitungan.

segments.src: ### 2. How Long Can Ballots Arrive After Election Day?
segments.tr: ### 2. Berapa Lama Surat Suara Dapat Tiba Setelah Hari Pemilu?

segments.src: States also differ on receipt deadlines.
segments.tr: Negara bagian juga berbeda dalam batas waktu penerimaan.

segments.src: Broadly, there are two approaches:
segments.tr: Secara garis besar, ada dua pendekatan:

segments.src: - **Received by Election Day:** The ballot must be in the election office by the time polls close. Anything arriving later is not counted.
segments.tr: - **Diterima pada Hari Pemilu:** Surat suara harus berada di kantor pemilu pada saat tempat pemungutan suara ditutup. Apa pun yang tiba terlambat tidak akan dihitung.

segments.src: - **Postmarked by Election Day:** The ballot must be mailed on or before Election Day, and it can still be counted if it arrives within a set window afterward, which varies by state from a few days to about a week or more.
segments.tr: - **Dicap pos pada Hari Pemilu:** Surat suara harus dikirimkan pada atau sebelum Hari Pemilu, dan masih dapat dihitung jika tiba dalam jangka waktu tertentu setelahnya, yang bervariasi menurut negara bagian dari beberapa hari hingga sekitar seminggu atau lebih.

segments.src: Military and overseas voters often have their own, longer deadlines under federal and state law.
segments.tr: Pemilih militer dan di luar negeri seringkali memiliki batas waktu mereka sendiri yang lebih lama di bawah hukum federal dan negara bagian.

segments.src: Receipt rules have also been the subject of litigation and legislative changes in recent years, so the details can differ from one election to the next.
segments.tr: Aturan penerimaan juga telah menjadi subjek litigasi dan perubahan legislatif dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, sehingga detailnya dapat berbeda dari satu pemilu ke pemilu berikutnya.

segments.src: ### 3. When Are Results Certified?
segments.tr: ### 3. Kapan Hasil Disahkan?

segments.src: Election night totals are always unofficial.
segments.tr: Total malam pemilu selalu tidak resmi.

segments.src: Counties typically certify first, then the state.
segments.tr: Kabupaten biasanya mengesahkan terlebih dahulu, kemudian negara bagian.

segments.src: Certification deadlines range from a matter of days to several weeks, depending on the state and the type of contest.
segments.tr: Batas waktu sertifikasi berkisar dari beberapa hari hingga beberapa minggu, tergantung pada negara bagian dan jenis kontesnya.

segments.src: This period includes reviewing provisional ballots, giving voters time to fix signature or paperwork problems (known as "curing"), and conducting audits or recounts when margins fall within legal thresholds.
segments.tr: Periode ini mencakup peninjauan surat suara provisional, memberikan waktu bagi pemilih untuk memperbaiki masalah tanda tangan atau dokumen (dikenal sebagai "penyembuhan"), dan melakukan audit atau penghitungan ulang ketika batas marjin berada dalam ambang batas hukum.

segments.src: ## Why Some Races Are Called Fast
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Beberapa Pemilihan Diumumkan dengan Cepat

segments.src: Media organizations and decision desks do not wait for every ballot.
segments.tr: Organisasi media dan meja keputusan tidak menunggu setiap surat suara.

segments.src: They call a race when the remaining uncounted votes cannot realistically change the outcome.
segments.tr: Mereka mengumumkan pemilihan ketika sisa suara yang belum dihitung tidak dapat secara realistis mengubah hasil.

segments.src: A race can be called quickly when:
segments.tr: Sebuah pemilihan dapat diumumkan dengan cepat ketika:

segments.src: - the margin is wide enough that outstanding ballots are mathematically irrelevant;
segments.tr: - marginnya cukup besar sehingga surat suara yang belum dihitung secara matematis tidak relevan;

segments.src: - the state processes mail ballots early and reports a large share of them soon after polls close;
segments.tr: - negara bagian memproses surat suara lebih awal dan melaporkan sebagian besar darinya segera setelah tempat pemungutan suara ditutup;

segments.src: - the number of late-arriving ballots is small.
segments.tr: - jumlah surat suara yang tiba terlambat sedikit.

segments.src: States with a long tradition of early processing and high-volume mail voting often report most of their vote on election night.
segments.tr: Negara bagian dengan tradisi panjang pemrosesan awal dan pemungutan suara melalui pos dengan volume tinggi sering melaporkan sebagian besar suara mereka pada malam pemilu.

segments.src: Races in these states can be called within hours.
segments.tr: Pemilihan di negara bagian ini dapat diumumkan dalam hitungan jam.

segments.src: ## Why Others Take Days
segments.tr: ## Mengapa yang Lainnya Membutuhkan Berhari-hari

segments.src: A race may stay uncalled when:
segments.tr: Sebuah pemilihan mungkin tetap tidak diumumkan ketika:

segments.src: - the margin is narrow, so even a modest number of outstanding ballots could matter;
segments.tr: - marginnya sempit, sehingga bahkan sejumlah kecil surat suara yang belum dihitung dapat berarti;

segments.src: - a large share of ballots are mail ballots that could not be processed until Election Day;
segments.tr: - sebagian besar surat suara adalah surat suara pos yang tidak dapat diproses hingga Hari Pemilu;

segments.src: - the state accepts ballots that arrive after Election Day;
segments.tr: - negara bagian menerima surat suara yang tiba setelah Hari Pemilu;

segments.src: - signature-cure periods are still running;
segments.tr: - periode penyembuhan tanda tangan masih berjalan;

segments.src: - many provisional ballots need to be reviewed.
segments.tr: - banyak surat suara provisional perlu ditinjau.

segments.src: In some places, the order in which ballots are counted can also create a temporary swing.
segments.tr: Di beberapa tempat, urutan di mana surat suara dihitung juga dapat menciptakan pergeseran sementara.

segments.src: If in-person votes are reported first, early totals may lean one way and shift as mail ballots are added.
segments.tr: Jika suara langsung dilaporkan terlebih dahulu, total awal mungkin condong ke satu arah dan bergeser saat surat suara ditambahkan.

segments.src: If mail ballots are reported first, the pattern can reverse.
segments.tr: Jika surat suara dilaporkan terlebih dahulu, polanya dapat berbalik.

segments.src: Neither pattern signals a problem.
segments.tr: Tidak ada pola yang menandakan masalah.

segments.src: It reflects which batches of ballots were reported when, and it is often described as a "red shift" or "blue shift" depending on the state.
segments.tr: Ini mencerminkan kelompok surat suara mana yang dilaporkan kapan, dan sering digambarkan sebagai "pergeseran merah" atau "pergeseran biru" tergantung pada negara bagian.

segments.src: The final tally is what counts.
segments.tr: Penghitungan akhir adalah yang terpenting.

segments.src: ## A Simple State-by-State Illustration
segments.tr: ## Ilustrasi Sederhana Negara Bagian demi Negara Bagian

segments.src: Without getting lost in the fine print, states tend to fall into broad groups:
segments.tr: Tanpa tersesat dalam cetakan kecil, negara bagian cenderung masuk ke dalam kelompok besar:

segments.src: - **Early processors with quick reporting:** States that allow processing well before Election Day, and that mostly require ballots to be received by Election Day, tend to report the bulk of results on election night.
segments.tr: - **Pemroses awal dengan pelaporan cepat:** Negara bagian yang mengizinkan pemrosesan jauh sebelum Hari Pemilu, dan yang sebagian besar mengharuskan surat suara diterima pada Hari Pemilu, cenderung melaporkan sebagian besar hasil pada malam pemilu.

segments.src: - **Universal mail states with grace periods:** States that mail a ballot to every registered voter and accept ballots postmarked by Election Day often report a large first batch on election night, then release additional batches over the following days as late-arriving ballots are verified and counted.
segments.tr: - **Negara bagian pos universal dengan masa tenggang:** Negara bagian yang mengirimkan surat suara ke setiap pemilih terdaftar dan menerima surat suara yang dicap pos pada Hari Pemilu sering melaporkan kelompok pertama yang besar pada malam pemilu, kemudian merilis kelompok tambahan selama hari-hari berikutnya saat surat suara yang tiba terlambat diverifikasi dan dihitung.

segments.src: - **Late processors:** States that historically restricted processing until Election Day have often needed more time, particularly when mail voting surged.
segments.tr: - **Pemroses akhir:** Negara bagian yang secara historis membatasi pemrosesan hingga Hari Pemilu sering membutuhkan lebih banyak waktu, terutama ketika pemungutan suara melalui pos melonjak.

segments.src: Individual states change their laws frequently, so the best source for current rules is always your state or county election office.
segments.tr: Negara bagian secara individu sering mengubah undang-undang mereka, jadi sumber terbaik untuk aturan saat ini selalu kantor pemilu negara bagian atau kabupaten Anda.

segments.src: ## What Voters Can Do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dapat Dilakukan Pemilih

segments.src: Understanding the timeline can make the days after an election less stressful.
segments.tr: Memahami garis waktu dapat membuat hari-hari setelah pemilu menjadi tidak terlalu menegangkan.

segments.src: - **Return your ballot early.** This reduces the chance of delays and leaves time to fix any problems.
segments.tr: - **Kembalikan surat suara Anda lebih awal.** Ini mengurangi kemungkinan penundaan dan menyisakan waktu untuk memperbaiki masalah apa pun.

segments.src: - **Track your ballot.** Many states offer online ballot tracking that shows when your ballot was received and accepted.
segments.tr: - **Lacak surat suara Anda.** Banyak negara bagian menawarkan pelacakan surat suara online yang menunjukkan kapan surat suara Anda diterima dan diterima.

segments.src: - **Respond to cure notices promptly.** If your signature is questioned, you are usually given a short window to confirm your ballot.
segments.tr: - **Tanggapi pemberitahuan penyembuhan dengan cepat.** Jika tanda tangan Anda dipertanyakan, Anda biasanya diberi waktu singkat untuk mengonfirmasi surat suara Anda.

segments.src: - **Check official sources.** County and state election websites publish updates, the schedule for results, and certification dates.
segments.tr: - **Periksa sumber resmi.** Situs web pemilu kabupaten dan negara bagian menerbitkan pembaruan, jadwal hasil, dan tanggal sertifikasi.

segments.src: - **Treat election night numbers as preliminary.** Unofficial results can change as additional ballots are counted.
segments.tr: - **Perlakukan angka malam pemilu sebagai pendahuluan.** Hasil tidak resmi dapat berubah saat surat suara tambahan dihitung.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: A slow count is not the same as a flawed count.
segments.tr: Penghitungan yang lambat tidak sama dengan penghitungan yang cacat.

segments.src: When it takes several days to know who won, it often means the system is doing what the law requires: verifying each ballot, giving eligible voters the full window the state allows, and finishing the canvass before certifying.
segments.tr: Ketika butuh beberapa hari untuk mengetahui siapa yang menang, itu sering berarti sistem melakukan apa yang diisyaratkan oleh hukum: memverifikasi setiap surat suara, memberikan pemilih yang memenuhi syarat jendela penuh yang diizinkan negara bagian, dan menyelesaikan kanvas sebelum mengesahkan.

segments.src: Knowing the rules in your state turns a confusing wait into a predictable process.
segments.tr: Mengetahui aturan di negara bagian Anda mengubah penantian yang membingungkan menjadi proses yang dapat diprediksi.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini untuk tujuan informasi umum.

segments.src: Election laws vary and change; consult your state or local election office for current deadlines and procedures.*
segments.tr: Undang-undang pemilu bervariasi dan berubah; konsultasikan dengan kantor pemilu negara bagian atau lokal Anda untuk batas waktu dan prosedur saat ini.*

us-20261016-news-1.title: Tanda Terima Belanja AI: Apa yang Akan Diungkapkan oleh Pendapatan Big Tech Minggu Depan Mengenai Taruhan Triliunan Dolar

segments.src: Over the next several days, some of the largest technology companies in the world will open their books for the latest quarter.
segments.tr: Over the next several days, some of the largest technology companies in the world will open their books for the latest quarter.

segments.src: Revenue and profit will get the headlines, as they always do.
segments.tr: Revenue and profit will get the headlines, as they always do.

segments.src: But this earnings season, the number many investors care about most sits a little further down the page: **how much these companies are spending on chips and data centers, and whether that spending is beginning to pay off.**
segments.tr: But this earnings season, the number many investors care about most sits a little further down the page: **how much these companies are spending on chips and data centers, and whether that spending is beginning to pay off.**

segments.src: That question matters well beyond Wall Street.
segments.tr: That question matters well beyond Wall Street.

segments.src: The answer can influence tech stock prices, the value of retirement accounts that hold them, and the pace of the broader economy.
segments.tr: The answer can influence tech stock prices, the value of retirement accounts that hold them, and the pace of the broader economy.

segments.src: ## Why this earnings season is different
segments.tr: ## Why this earnings season is different

segments.src: For years, big tech earnings followed a familiar script: advertising, cloud subscriptions, devices and software.
segments.tr: For years, big tech earnings followed a familiar script: advertising, cloud subscriptions, devices and software.

segments.src: Since the rise of generative artificial intelligence, a new line item has taken center stage.
segments.tr: Since the rise of generative artificial intelligence, a new line item has taken center stage.

segments.src: **Capital expenditures**, often shortened to "capex," refers to money spent on long-lived assets such as data centers, servers, networking gear and specialized AI chips.
segments.tr: **Capital expenditures**, often shortened to "capex," refers to money spent on long-lived assets such as data centers, servers, networking gear and specialized AI chips.

segments.src: Across the industry, the combined capex plans of the largest cloud and platform companies have climbed to levels that analysts often describe in the hundreds of billions of dollars per year.
segments.tr: Across the industry, the combined capex plans of the largest cloud and platform companies have climbed to levels that analysts often describe in the hundreds of billions of dollars per year.

segments.src: Taken together with commitments over several years, the total is frequently framed as a trillion-dollar bet that AI will become a core part of how people and businesses work.
segments.tr: Taken together with commitments over several years, the total is frequently framed as a trillion-dollar bet that AI will become a core part of how people and businesses work.

segments.src: A bet that large raises an obvious question: where is the return?
segments.tr: A bet that large raises an obvious question: where is the return?

segments.src: ## What investors will be watching
segments.tr: ## What investors will be watching

segments.src: Analysts and investors are likely to focus on a handful of signals:
segments.tr: Analysts and investors are likely to focus on a handful of signals:

segments.src: - **Capex guidance.** Did companies raise, hold or trim their spending plans for the coming year? A higher number can signal confidence in demand, but it can also raise worries about profit margins.
segments.tr: - **Capex guidance.** Did companies raise, hold or trim their spending plans for the coming year? A higher number can signal confidence in demand, but it can also raise worries about profit margins.

segments.src: - **Cloud growth.** Cloud divisions are where much of the AI demand shows up first. Faster growth, and commentary about backlogs of customer commitments, would suggest the infrastructure is being put to use.
segments.tr: - **Cloud growth.** Cloud divisions are where much of the AI demand shows up first. Faster growth, and commentary about backlogs of customer commitments, would suggest the infrastructure is being put to use.

segments.src: - **Capacity constraints.** Executives often say demand exceeds the computing capacity they can supply. If that remains true, it supports the case for continued building. If it fades, the tone may change.
segments.tr: - **Capacity constraints.** Executives often say demand exceeds the computing capacity they can supply. If that remains true, it supports the case for continued building. If it fades, the tone may change.

segments.src: - **Margins and depreciation.** Servers and chips lose value over time, and that cost flows through the income statement as depreciation. Rising depreciation can weigh on profits even when revenue is growing.
segments.tr: - **Margins and depreciation.** Servers and chips lose value over time, and that cost flows through the income statement as depreciation. Rising depreciation can weigh on profits even when revenue is growing.

segments.src: - **AI revenue disclosure.** Some companies share figures on AI-related products or customer usage. Any new detail on how many people and businesses are paying for these tools will be closely scrutinized.
segments.tr: - **AI revenue disclosure.** Some companies share figures on AI-related products or customer usage. Any new detail on how many people and businesses are paying for these tools will be closely scrutinized.

segments.src: - **Free cash flow.** When spending rises quickly, the cash left over after investment can shrink. Investors will check whether companies are funding the buildout from operations or leaning more on debt.
segments.tr: - **Free cash flow.** When spending rises quickly, the cash left over after investment can shrink. Investors will check whether companies are funding the buildout from operations or leaning more on debt.

segments.src: ## The case for patience
segments.tr: ## The case for patience

segments.src: Supporters of the spending argue that large infrastructure cycles take time to mature.
segments.tr: Supporters of the spending argue that large infrastructure cycles take time to mature.

segments.src: Railroads, electric grids and the early internet all required heavy upfront investment before their economic benefits became clear.
segments.tr: Railroads, electric grids and the early internet all required heavy upfront investment before their economic benefits became clear.

segments.src: In this view, the companies building AI capacity today are positioning for a long period of growth, and falling behind could be costlier than overbuilding.
segments.tr: In this view, the companies building AI capacity today are positioning for a long period of growth, and falling behind could be costlier than overbuilding.

segments.src: There is also evidence that businesses are experimenting widely with AI for coding assistance, customer service, document analysis and research.
segments.tr: There is also evidence that businesses are experimenting widely with AI for coding assistance, customer service, document analysis and research.

segments.src: If those pilots turn into everyday workflows, demand for computing power could keep rising.
segments.tr: If those pilots turn into everyday workflows, demand for computing power could keep rising.

segments.src: ## The case for caution
segments.tr: ## The case for caution

segments.src: Skeptics point out that spending is arriving faster than proven revenue.
segments.tr: Skeptics point out that spending is arriving faster than proven revenue.

segments.src: They note that some of the demand comes from a relatively small group of AI developers and that companies are, in part, selling to customers they also fund.
segments.tr: They note that some of the demand comes from a relatively small group of AI developers and that companies are, in part, selling to customers they also fund.

segments.src: They also ask whether the pace of chip upgrades will make today's hardware obsolete sooner than expected, shortening the period in which it can earn a return.
segments.tr: They also ask whether the pace of chip upgrades will make today's hardware obsolete sooner than expected, shortening the period in which it can earn a return.

segments.src: Power supply is another constraint.
segments.tr: Power supply is another constraint.

segments.src: Data centers need large amounts of electricity, and delays in securing grid connections or equipment can slow projects and raise costs.
segments.tr: Data centers need large amounts of electricity, and delays in securing grid connections or equipment can slow projects and raise costs.

segments.src: History offers a cautionary note: periods of enthusiastic building have sometimes been followed by corrections when expectations ran ahead of results.
segments.tr: History offers a cautionary note: periods of enthusiastic building have sometimes been followed by corrections when expectations ran ahead of results.

segments.src: Whether this cycle follows that path is exactly what investors are trying to judge.
segments.tr: Whether this cycle follows that path is exactly what investors are trying to judge.

segments.src: ## Why it matters to everyday households
segments.tr: ## Why it matters to everyday households

segments.src: Many people own these companies without realizing it.
segments.tr: Many people own these companies without realizing it.

segments.src: Large technology firms make up a significant share of popular index funds, and those funds sit inside 401(k)s, IRAs and target-date retirement portfolios.
segments.tr: Large technology firms make up a significant share of popular index funds, and those funds sit inside 401(k)s, IRAs and target-date retirement portfolios.

segments.src: When a handful of companies move sharply, broad market indexes can move with them.
segments.tr: When a handful of companies move sharply, broad market indexes can move with them.

segments.src: The effects reach further than portfolios:
segments.tr: The effects reach further than portfolios:

segments.src: - **Jobs and construction.** Data center projects support work in construction, electrical equipment and energy.
segments.tr: - **Jobs and construction.** Data center projects support work in construction, electrical equipment and energy.

segments.src: - **Utilities and electricity demand.** Growing computing needs are influencing power planning in some regions.
segments.tr: - **Utilities and electricity demand.** Growing computing needs are influencing power planning in some regions.

segments.src: - **Business investment.** AI-related spending has become a noticeable contributor to overall corporate investment in the economy.
segments.tr: - **Business investment.** AI-related spending has become a noticeable contributor to overall corporate investment in the economy.

segments.src: - **Consumer products.** The tools built on this infrastructure are showing up in search, productivity software, phones and customer service.
segments.tr: - **Consumer products.** The tools built on this infrastructure are showing up in search, productivity software, phones and customer service.

segments.src: ## How to read the results
segments.tr: ## How to read the results

segments.src: A few practical tips for following the news without getting lost in the noise:
segments.tr: A few practical tips for following the news without getting lost in the noise:

segments.src: 1. **Compare spending to growth.** A big capex number means little without context. Look at it alongside cloud revenue growth and operating margins.
segments.tr: 1. **Compare spending to growth.** A big capex number means little without context. Look at it alongside cloud revenue growth and operating margins.

segments.src: 2. **Listen to the tone on the call.** Language about demand, capacity and timelines often tells you more than a single figure.
segments.tr: 2. **Listen to the tone on the call.** Language about demand, capacity and timelines often tells you more than a single figure.

segments.src: 3. **Remember that one quarter is a snapshot.** Infrastructure returns play out over years, and stock reactions on earnings day can be short-lived.
segments.tr: 3. **Remember that one quarter is a snapshot.** Infrastructure returns play out over years, and stock reactions on earnings day can be short-lived.

segments.src: 4. **Mind your own concentration.** If much of your savings is tied to a few large technology names, it may be worth understanding how your funds are weighted.
segments.tr: 4. **Mind your own concentration.** If much of your savings is tied to a few large technology names, it may be worth understanding how your funds are weighted.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## The bottom line

segments.src: Next week's reports will not settle the debate over whether the AI buildout is a visionary investment or an overreach.
segments.tr: Next week's reports will not settle the debate over whether the AI buildout is a visionary investment or an overreach.

segments.src: But they will add fresh evidence on both sides: how fast the spending is growing, how much customers are paying for it, and how comfortably companies can afford it.
segments.tr: But they will add fresh evidence on both sides: how fast the spending is growing, how much customers are paying for it, and how comfortably companies can afford it.

segments.src: For investors and savers alike, the receipt for the AI boom is starting to come into view.
segments.tr: For investors and savers alike, the receipt for the AI boom is starting to come into view.

segments.src: How it reads may shape markets well into the new year.
segments.tr: How it reads may shape markets well into the new year.

us-20261016-intro-logistics-13.title: [Logistics 101 #13] Paket Anda Berpindah Dua Kali. Datanya Berpindah Lima Puluh Kali.

segments.src: > Warehouses and trucks move boxes, but software decides which box, which truck, and when — and that software is really three systems (WMS, TMS, ERP) stitched together by scans.
segments.tr: > Gudang dan truk memindahkan kotak, tetapi perangkat lunaklah yang memutuskan kotak mana, truk mana, dan kapan — dan perangkat lunak itu sebenarnya terdiri dari tiga sistem (WMS, TMS, ERP) yang disatukan oleh pemindaian.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Picture the last thing you ordered online.
segments.tr: Bayangkan barang terakhir yang Anda pesan secara daring.

segments.src: Physically, it made maybe four moves: shelf to tote, tote to box, box to trailer, trailer to your porch.
segments.tr: Secara fisik, barang itu mungkin mengalami sekitar empat perpindahan: dari rak ke keranjang, dari keranjang ke kardus, dari kardus ke trailer, dari trailer ke teras rumah Anda.

segments.src: Digitally, it triggered dozens of transactions — an order record, an inventory allocation, a pick task, a carton label, a rate quote, a load tender, six or seven tracking scans, an invoice.
segments.tr: Secara digital, pesanan itu memicu puluhan transaksi — catatan pesanan, alokasi inventaris, tugas pengambilan, label karton, penawaran tarif, penawaran muatan, enam atau tujuh pemindaian pelacakan, dan sebuah faktur.

segments.src: That digital layer is the **logistics information system**, and in most companies it's not one product.
segments.tr: Lapisan digital itu adalah **sistem informasi logistik**, dan di kebanyakan perusahaan, sistem ini bukan satu produk.

segments.src: It's three, each with its own job:
segments.tr: Ada tiga, masing-masing dengan tugasnya sendiri:

segments.src: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)** is the system of record — the company's books.
segments.tr: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)** adalah sistem catatan utama — buku besar perusahaan.

segments.src: It holds the customer order, the purchase order, the item master, the price, the general ledger.
segments.tr: Sistem ini menyimpan pesanan pelanggan, pesanan pembelian, data induk barang, harga, dan buku besar umum.

segments.src: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.
segments.tr: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.

segments.src: The ERP knows *what* was promised to whom, but it has almost no idea where any physical carton is sitting right now.
segments.tr: ERP mengetahui *apa* yang dijanjikan kepada siapa, tetapi hampir tidak tahu di mana sebuah karton fisik berada saat ini.

segments.src: **WMS (Warehouse Management System)** runs everything inside the four walls.
segments.tr: **WMS (Warehouse Management System)** menjalankan semua hal di dalam dinding gudang.

segments.src: It directs receiving, decides where to putaway a pallet (slotting), generates pick tasks in an efficient walk path, controls packing and cartonization, manages cycle counts, and produces the shipping label.
segments.tr: Sistem ini mengatur penerimaan barang, memutuskan di mana menempatkan palet (slotting), membuat tugas pengambilan dengan rute jalan yang efisien, mengendalikan pengemasan dan pembentukan karton (cartonization), mengelola perhitungan siklus (cycle count), dan mencetak label pengiriman.

segments.src: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.
segments.tr: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.

segments.src: The WMS is the only system that truly knows that SKU 44821 is in aisle 12, bin B, quantity 63.
segments.tr: WMS adalah satu-satunya sistem yang benar-benar tahu bahwa SKU 44821 ada di lorong 12, bin B, jumlah 63.

segments.src: **TMS (Transportation Management System)** takes over once freight leaves the dock — and often before.
segments.tr: **TMS (Transportation Management System)** mengambil alih begitu barang keluar dari dok — dan sering kali bahkan sebelumnya.

segments.src: It rates and compares carriers, picks the mode (parcel, LTL, truckload, intermodal), consolidates small orders into one load, tenders that load to a carrier, tracks it, and audits the freight bill against the contracted rate.
segments.tr: Sistem ini menilai dan membandingkan vendor angkut (carrier), memilih moda (paket, LTL, truk muatan penuh, intermodal), menggabungkan pesanan kecil menjadi satu muatan, menawarkan muatan itu kepada vendor angkut, melacaknya, dan mengaudit tagihan angkutan terhadap tarif kontrak.

segments.src: Overpaying carriers is shockingly common without one; freight audit alone often pays for the software.
segments.tr: Membayar kelebihan kepada vendor angkut sangat umum tanpa sistem ini; audit angkutan saja sering kali sudah menutupi biaya perangkat lunaknya.

segments.src: The hard part isn't any single system.
segments.tr: Bagian yang sulit bukanlah sistem tunggal mana pun.

segments.src: It's **the seams**.
segments.tr: Melainkan **sambungan antarsistem**.

segments.src: In the U.S., those seams are usually crossed one of two ways: **EDI**, the decades-old transaction-set standard (a 940 tells the warehouse to ship, a 945 confirms it shipped, a 204 tenders a load to a trucker, a 214 sends status updates back, an 856 is the advance ship notice that tells the retailer what's on the truck), or modern **APIs**, which do the same thing in near real time.
segments.tr: Di AS, sambungan ini biasanya dilintasi dengan dua cara: **EDI**, standar set transaksi yang sudah berpuluh-puluh tahun (940 memberi tahu gudang untuk mengirim, 945 mengonfirmasi bahwa barang sudah dikirim, 204 menawarkan muatan kepada pengangkut, 214 mengirim pembaruan status kembali, 856 adalah advance ship notice yang memberi tahu peritel apa yang ada di truk), atau **API** modern, yang melakukan hal yang sama hampir secara real time.

segments.src: A retail vendor who mis-formats an 856 gets a chargeback, not an email.
segments.tr: Vendor ritel yang salah memformat 856 akan mendapat chargeback, bukan sekadar email.

segments.src: And all of it runs on one humble input: **the scan**.
segments.tr: Dan semua ini berjalan dengan satu masukan sederhana: **pemindaian**.

segments.src: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)
segments.tr: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)

segments.src: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit
segments.tr: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit

segments.src: **Barcodes** are the workhorse.
segments.tr: **Barcode** adalah kuda pekerja utamanya.

segments.src: A UPC identifies the product; a GS1-128 label on a pallet carries an SSCC — an 18-digit serial number that acts as a "license plate" so one scan pulls up the entire contents of that pallet.
segments.tr: UPC mengidentifikasi produk; label GS1-128 pada palet membawa SSCC — nomor seri 18 digit yang berfungsi sebagai "nomor plat" sehingga satu pemindaian menampilkan seluruh isi palet tersebut.

segments.src: Barcodes are effectively free to print, but they need line of sight and one read at a time.
segments.tr: Barcode praktis murah untuk dicetak, tetapi membutuhkan garis pandang dan pembacaan satu per satu.

segments.src: **RFID** (in retail supply chains, usually passive UHF "RAIN" RFID) flips that.
segments.tr: **RFID** (dalam rantai pasok ritel, biasanya RFID UHF pasif "RAIN") membalik hal itu.

segments.src: A reader can pick up hundreds of tags at once, through a cardboard box, without anyone aiming anything.
segments.tr: Pembaca dapat menangkap ratusan tag sekaligus, menembus kardus, tanpa seorang pun perlu mengarahkannya.

segments.src: Walk a handheld down a store aisle and count the inventory in minutes instead of hours.
segments.tr: Bawa perangkat genggam menyusuri lorong toko dan hitung inventaris dalam hitungan menit, bukan jam.

segments.src: The tradeoff is cost and physics: tags cost a few cents each at volume rather than nothing, and radio waves behave badly around metal and liquid.
segments.tr: Komprominya adalah biaya dan fisika: tag berharga beberapa sen masing-masing dalam volume besar, dan gelombang radio berperilaku buruk di dekat logam dan cairan.

segments.src: That's why RFID took off first in apparel — light, non-metallic, high SKU count, and painful to count by hand — and why Walmart's expansion of its RFID tagging requirements beyond apparel starting in 2022 pushed a lot of suppliers into it.
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya RFID pertama kali berkembang di industri pakaian — ringan, nonlogam, jumlah SKU tinggi, dan sulit dihitung manual — dan mengapa perluasan persyaratan pemasangan tag RFID Walmart di luar pakaian mulai 2022 mendorong banyak pemasok untuk menggunakannya.

segments.src: The unglamorous truth: none of this fixes bad data.
segments.tr: Kenyataan yang tidak glamor: tidak satu pun dari ini memperbaiki data yang buruk.

segments.src: If a receiver scans a pallet into the wrong bin, the WMS confidently tells a picker to walk to an empty shelf.
segments.tr: Jika penerima barang memindai palet ke bin yang salah, WMS dengan yakin memberi tahu pengambil untuk berjalan ke rak kosong.

segments.src: Garbage in, expensive walk out.
segments.tr: Masukan buruk, jalan kaki yang mahal.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: It's 11 p.m.
segments.tr: Sekarang pukul 23.00

segments.src: in Columbus, Ohio, and you order a $110 pair of running shoes with free two-day shipping.
segments.tr: di Columbus, Ohio, dan Anda memesan sepasang sepatu lari seharga $110 dengan pengiriman gratis dua hari.

segments.src: The retailer's **ERP** captures the order and the payment.
segments.tr: **ERP** peritel menangkap pesanan dan pembayaran.

segments.src: Available-to-promise logic checks inventory and assigns it to a fulfillment center in Indiana rather than the one in Nevada — closer to you, cheaper to ship, and the shoes are actually there.
segments.tr: Logika available-to-promise memeriksa inventaris dan menugaskannya ke pusat distribusi di Indiana, bukan yang di Nevada — lebih dekat dengan Anda, lebih murah untuk dikirim, dan sepatunya memang ada di sana.

segments.src: The **WMS** drops a pick task onto a handheld.
segments.tr: **WMS** menjatuhkan tugas pengambilan ke perangkat genggam.

segments.src: A picker walks a route the system optimized, scans the shelf barcode (confirming the right location), scans the shoe box (confirming the right SKU), and drops it in a tote.
segments.tr: Pengambil berjalan mengikuti rute yang dioptimalkan sistem, memindai barcode rak (memastikan lokasinya benar), memindai kotak sepatu (memastikan SKU-nya benar), lalu memasukkannya ke keranjang.

segments.src: Packing scans it again into a carton and prints a label.
segments.tr: Pengemasan memindainya lagi ke dalam karton dan mencetak label.

segments.src: Every one of those scans is the system asking "prove it" — that's how inventory records stay honest.
segments.tr: Setiap pemindaian itu adalah sistem yang bertanya "buktikan" — begitulah catatan inventaris tetap jujur.

segments.src: The **TMS** — or the parcel-rating engine that plays its role — compares carriers and service levels for that ZIP code, picks one, and transmits the shipment data before the box is even on the trailer.
segments.tr: **TMS** — atau mesin penilaian paket yang menjalankan perannya — membandingkan vendor angkut dan tingkat layanan untuk kode pos tersebut, memilih salah satu, dan mengirimkan data pengiriman sebelum kotak bahkan berada di trailer.

segments.src: That's why your tracking number goes live with "label created" while the box is still sitting in Indiana.
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya nomor pelacakan Anda aktif dengan status "label dibuat" saat kotak masih berada di Indiana.

segments.src: Overnight the trailer runs to a sort hub — Memphis, Louisville, wherever the network routes it.
segments.tr: Semalaman trailer berjalan ke hub penyortiran — Memphis, Louisville, mana pun yang dirutekan jaringan.

segments.src: Each scan there is a status message flowing back upstream, which is what refreshes the tracking page you check at breakfast.
segments.tr: Setiap pemindaian di sana adalah pesan status yang mengalir kembali ke hulu, yang menyegarkan halaman pelacakan yang Anda cek saat sarapan.

segments.src: Two days later it's on your porch.
segments.tr: Dua hari kemudian barang sampai di teras Anda.

segments.src: You saw six tracking updates.
segments.tr: Anda melihat enam pembaruan pelacakan.

segments.src: The systems exchanged roughly fifty messages, and any one of them going quiet is what turns "out for delivery" into a support ticket.
segments.tr: Sistem-sistem tersebut bertukar sekitar lima puluh pesan, dan jika salah satunya terhenti, itulah yang mengubah "sedang diantar" menjadi tiket dukungan.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Rangkuman Tiga Baris

segments.src: 1. Logistics runs on three cooperating systems: ERP (the order and the books), WMS (inside the warehouse), TMS (freight and carriers).
segments.tr: 1. Logistik berjalan di atas tiga sistem yang saling bekerja sama: ERP (pesanan dan catatan keuangan), WMS (di dalam gudang), TMS (angkutan dan vendor angkut).

segments.src: 2. They talk through EDI transaction sets or APIs, and the integration seams — not the individual systems — are where most projects fail.
segments.tr: 2. Mereka berkomunikasi melalui set transaksi EDI atau API, dan sambungan antarsistem — bukan masing-masing sistem — adalah tempat sebagian besar proyek gagal.

segments.src: 3. Barcodes and RFID are the data-capture layer; without accurate scans, every system downstream is confidently wrong.
segments.tr: 3. Barcode dan RFID adalah lapisan penangkapan data; tanpa pemindaian yang akurat, setiap sistem di hilir akan salah dengan yakin.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri

segments.src: **1.** A distribution center needs to decide which bin to store an incoming pallet in, and which pick path a worker should walk.
segments.tr: **1.** Pusat distribusi perlu memutuskan bin mana untuk menyimpan palet masuk, dan rute pengambilan mana yang harus dilalui pekerja.

segments.src: Which system handles this?
segments.tr: Sistem mana yang menangani ini?

segments.src: - A) ERP
segments.tr: - A) ERP

segments.src: - B) WMS
segments.tr: - B) WMS

segments.src: - C) TMS
segments.tr: - C) TMS

segments.src: - D) EDI
segments.tr: - D) EDI

segments.src: **2.** True or False: The main advantage of RFID over barcodes is that RFID tags are cheaper per unit.
segments.tr: **2.** Benar atau Salah: Keunggulan utama RFID dibandingkan barcode adalah tag RFID lebih murah per unit.

segments.src: **3.** Your company is overpaying carriers because nobody checks freight invoices against contracted rates.
segments.tr: **3.** Perusahaan Anda membayar kelebihan kepada vendor angkut karena tidak ada yang memeriksa faktur angkutan terhadap tarif kontrak.

segments.src: Which capability addresses this most directly?
segments.tr: Kemampuan mana yang paling langsung mengatasi hal ini?

segments.src: - A) Cycle counting in the WMS
segments.tr: - A) Perhitungan siklus di WMS

segments.src: - B) Freight audit and pay in the TMS
segments.tr: - B) Audit dan pembayaran angkutan di TMS

segments.src: - C) The item master in the ERP
segments.tr: - C) Data induk barang di ERP

segments.src: - D) SSCC license plate labels
segments.tr: - D) Label plat nomor SSCC

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini

segments.src: - **WMS (Warehouse Management System):** Software that directs work inside the warehouse — receiving, putaway, slotting, picking, packing, and cycle counting.
segments.tr: - **WMS (Warehouse Management System):** Perangkat lunak yang mengarahkan pekerjaan di dalam gudang — penerimaan, putaway, slotting, pengambilan, pengemasan, dan perhitungan siklus.

segments.src: - **TMS (Transportation Management System):** Software that selects carriers and modes, consolidates and tenders loads, tracks freight, and audits carrier invoices.
segments.tr: - **TMS (Transportation Management System):** Perangkat lunak yang memilih vendor angkut dan moda, menggabungkan serta menawarkan muatan, melacak barang, dan mengaudit faktur vendor angkut.

segments.src: - **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning):** The company-wide system of record for orders, purchasing, item master data, and finance — the source WMS and TMS take direction from.
segments.tr: - **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning):** Sistem catatan utama seluruh perusahaan untuk pesanan, pembelian, data induk barang, dan keuangan — sumber yang menjadi acuan WMS dan TMS.

segments.src: - **EDI (Electronic Data Interchange):** Standardized business documents exchanged machine-to-machine (e.g., 856 advance ship notice, 214 shipment status), still the backbone of U.S. retail supply chains.
segments.tr: - **EDI (Electronic Data Interchange):** Dokumen bisnis terstandar yang dipertukarkan antarmesin (mis. 856 advance ship notice, 214 status pengiriman), yang hingga kini menjadi tulang punggung rantai pasok ritel AS.

segments.src: - **SSCC / license plate:** An 18-digit serial number in a GS1-128 barcode on a pallet or carton, letting one scan retrieve everything that unit contains.
segments.tr: - **SSCC / nomor plat:** Nomor seri 18 digit dalam barcode GS1-128 pada palet atau karton, yang memungkinkan satu pemindaian mengambil semua isi unit tersebut.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** The WMS owns everything inside the four walls, including slotting and pick-path logic; the ERP holds the order, not the bin location.
segments.tr: *Jawaban: **1 — B.** WMS mengelola semua hal di dalam dinding gudang, termasuk logika slotting dan jalur pengambilan; ERP menyimpan pesanan, bukan lokasi bin.

segments.src: **2 — False.** RFID tags cost more than a printed barcode; the real advantage is bulk, no-line-of-sight reading — hundreds of tags at once, through packaging.
segments.tr: **2 — Salah.** Tag RFID lebih mahal daripada barcode cetak; keunggulan sebenarnya adalah pembacaan massal tanpa garis pandang — ratusan tag sekaligus, menembus kemasan.

segments.src: **3 — B.** Freight audit and pay is a core TMS function, and recovering billing errors is often how a TMS pays for itself.*
segments.tr: **3 — B.** Audit dan pembayaran angkutan adalah fungsi inti TMS, dan pemulihan kesalahan penagihan sering kali menjadi cara TMS membayar dirinya sendiri.*
